info.title: AgriPulse Backend
info.description: Crop planning API for smallholder farmers in Maharashtra. Every number shown to the farmer carries a source, date and status.

get.description:
Deployment check and warm-up ping.

Returns 200 as soon as the app is up. models_loaded and data_files are
updated in-place by the lifespan warm-up.

C.4 — exposes every SSE payload as an OpenAPI-visible response model.

OpenAPI cannot describe a stream, so this stub endpoint declares all SSE
event shapes so the TypeScript generator picks them up.  The frontend
generates its types from these; it must not hand-write them.

schema.title: Response Sse Schemas Api Schemas Sse Events Get

post.description:
E2 — Plan from a complete profile, no agent. Target: warm response under 5 s.

explanation.provider = 'template' (no LLM calls).

E3 — Re-solve with new risk/budget/scenario using the stored plan inputs.
No external API calls. Target: under 1.5 s.
Writes changed field back to agent checkpointer so chat follow-ups stay consistent.

E1 — One conversation turn, streamed as SSE.

Request body:
  thread_id?      omit on first turn; response creates one
  message         farmer's text or transcription
  language?       mr | hi | en  (default: mr)
  profile_patch?  partial FarmProfile override (card edit, no message needed)
  district?       pre-fill district if known

get.description: E4 — Restore profile + last plan + messages for page reload (F14).

schema.title: Response Get Thread Api Threads  Thread Id  Get

post.description:
E5 — Audio → text + detected language (F1 mic button).

Accepted: webm/ogg/wav/mp3/mp4 (mp4 required for iOS Safari).
Max size: 10 MB, max duration: 60 s.

schema.title: Response Transcribe Audio Api Transcribe Post

post.description:
E6 — Text → audio/wav (F10 spoken reply).

Returns audio/wav bytes, or 503 if Sarvam is unavailable
(frontend falls back to browser speechSynthesis).

E7 — Warm caches for a location while the farmer is still talking (F16).
Failure here NEVER blocks a plan.

schema.title: Response Search Locations Api Locations Search Get
